title: AssetConstructor
description: Any abstract or concrete constructor whose instances are the resource an asset type produces (e.g. `typeof Texture`, `typeof Sound`). Constructors act as the dispatch token of a constructor-bound asset binding: they identify the type a request is routed to and take part in its resource identity. A first-class AssetType carries its own stable string identity instead and needs no constructor of its own.
